support_psnr_interpretation.explanation: blur_glass uses seedless random pixel shuffle, so target pixels cannot be reproduced even with the correct function and severity (SKILL C4 warns not to chase 40 dB for non-deterministic glass). The per-pair simulation ceilings are 34.67/28.47/38.87 dB and are dominated by pair1 near 28.5 dB; a specialist trained on glass-simulated data cannot exceed that shuffle-induced residual on the GT pairs. Support PSNR 26.79 < 35 is therefore consistent with a stochastic-blur evaluation ceiling, not with a wrong pipeline; no validated alternative pipeline exists.

limitations: k=3 support pairs only; pair-level PSNR differences are dominated by content-dependent shuffle residuals
